text:
maria: spotting intermittent p99 spikes on rack-usw3-12 around 02:40 UTC. GPUs high but not fully saturated; NIC err counters ticked.

infra-bot: ALERT: rx-errors-high on rack-usw3-12 (hosts 18.45.12.*) - https://telemetry/internal/ALRT-8010

kevin: short tail: looks like a mix of small low-latency chat workloads and a new large beam-search job that launched last night. beam job is noisy on PCIe and causes DMA bursts.

lana: can we apply a micro-ratecap for the slice id `slice-9090`? It's hosting both chat and beam. Micro-cap to 200mbps for 15m to see impact.

maria: if cap helps we'll avoid spinning up a fractional dedicated slice. cost of that ded slice ~ $2/hr plus warmup churn.

kevin: applied cap via allocator API, propagation ~60s. initial telemetry shows rx_errors declining and p99 dropping to previous baseline within 4m.

lana: filing follow-up: add pre-placement egress check to warm-pool flow and a telemetry alert that correlates pci_stalls + rx_errors.

infra-bot: RESOLVED: ALRT-8010 closed at 1887654469 (p99 recovered).
